Name: Rain colors updated for 1.6
Author: nilriMFallout
Description:
The mod has now been updated to work in 1.6, redid the colors, changed a few of them. the pinkpurple color has now become pastel, and orange has now become squash. Took in game pictures of the colors and menu, resample on and off.

Hello, this mod changes your rain color to a pretty purple, an Acid Green, or a Dark Blue, soft blue, pink, pastel, squash, and fall, just install through your mod manager or unzip and place it in your mods folder :) Ok, I figured out how to package them together and make a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] menu to swap colors in game! now you can have them all at once, no need to choose, more colors to come! Must have Content patcher to use. I also wanted to say that I got the idea for making rain colors from this mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9825]Rainbow Rain[/url], you should go check it out :)  The Author of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9825]Rainbow Rain[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/dunnisimtrouble?gameId=1303]dunnisimtrouble[/url], Has given me permission to include their Rainbow rain color as an option to my mod! Thank you so much! Go download their mod to endorse it as well! (You cannot have my mod and their mod installed at the same time!)

Downloads.Description: Added more colors! Added the Rainbow rain color with permission, added a Void rain color, add a Gothic rain color, and add a Pink Gothic rain color! :)
